# `team.delete`

Delete a team

Session-only, organization owners. The owners team cannot be deleted. Requires If-Match.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/teams/{team}/delete`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie team delete`
- MCP: `team_delete`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `If-Match` | header | no | `string` |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |
| `team` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `precondition-required`, `stale`, `unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
